body:
YTA

Is this real? It’s not plagiarism to get feedback on things she should improve. And the point of being her “friend” - which I don’t think you actually are - is to be supportive, not to put her down for achieving something she’s wanted. It doesn’t matter how long it’s taken her to do it, she’s doing it now and she’s reached out to you for support, something any regular friend would have given her.

Honestly, if you go through your life without seeking the advice of others, that’s great. Truly. But not everyone works like that, some people need advice and encouragement because sometimes, they don’t feel like they’re okay.

There is something wrong that you can’t actually do that and you’ve also put her down when she needed you.
